en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a large European town square bordered by ornate multi‑storey buildings in Central‑European style. On the left stands a Renaissance/Gothic town hall with arcades; near its center rises a tall square church tower with clock faces and a steep spire. Next to it is a Baroque church façade. On the right are richly decorated burgher houses with gables and clocks, including one building with a distinctive bulbous onion‑shaped dome. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk and gather around the open square, where there are a few trees and small monuments or fountains.
